abstract: Certain embryonal tumors demonstrate a loss of heterozygosity at the parentally imprinted region of chromosome 11p15.5. It has been hypothesized that this implicates a tumor suppressor gene at this locus. The human H19 gene maps to 11p15.5, is expressed in fetal tissues including the placenta and is paternally imprinted. Here we show that the abundance of H19 transcripts in cells of two choriocarcinoma derived cell lines (JAr and JEG-3) differs greatly. While JAr cells express high levels of H19 RNA, the expression of H19 in JEG-3 cells is much lower than that of normal trophoblasts. Cells of these two cell lines were subcutaneously injected into nude mice with subsequent tumor formation. A fivefold increase in the H19 RNA level was measured in tumors derived from JEG-3 cell lines as compared to these cells before injection. However this increase in H19 RNA did not alter the clonogenicity in soft agar nor the growth rate of the cells derived from these tumors as compared to the original JEG-3 cells. Nevertheless, the cells retaining the elevated level of H19 transcripts were more tumorigenic than the original cells. We propose that there is a selection of cells expressing high levels of H19 from the total JEG-3 cell population during the microevolution of tumor formation. These observations, together with our previous publications on H19 expression in human cancers, do not support the notion of a tumor suppressor role for the H19 gene.
abstract_ja: 染色体11p15.5の父性刷り込み領域のヘテロ接合性の消失は、一部の胚細胞性腫瘍で認められ、この領域の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆されてきた。ヒトH19遺伝子は11p15.5に位置し、胎盤を含む胎児組織で発現し、父性刷り込みを受ける。本研究では、絨毛癌由来の2つの細胞株(JArおよびJEG-3)におけるH19転写産物の量が大きく異なることを示す。JAr細胞は高いH19 RNAを発現するのに対し、JEG-3細胞のH19発現は正常栄養膜細胞よりはるかに低い。両細胞株をヌードマウスに皮下移植すると腫瘍が形成された。JEG-3由来の腫瘍では、移植前の細胞と比べてH19 RNA量が5倍に増加していた。しかし、このH19 RNAの増加は、これらの腫瘍由来細胞の軟寒天中でのコロニー形成能や増殖速度を、元のJEG-3細胞と比べて変化させなかった。それでも、高いH19転写産物量を保持した細胞は、元の細胞よりも腫瘍形成能が高かった。腫瘍形成の過程で、JEG-3細胞集団の中からH19を高発現する細胞が選択されると考えられる。これらの結果と、ヒト癌におけるH19発現に関する我々の以前の報告は、H19遺伝子の腫瘍抑制的役割を支持しない。
